guidance.upgrade_template: Upgrade to PHP {fixed_version} or a later supported release.
guidance.supported_branch_upgrade: Move to a currently supported PHP branch and apply the latest security release.
guidance.patched_upstream: Maintain current security patching and monitor future PHP advisories.
guidance.patched_vendor: Maintain the vendor-supported package and preserve the advisory/package evidence establishing the backport.

cves.title: RCE via stale global request state
temporary_mitigations: Until PHP's next regular bugfix release, consider setting session.upload_progress.enabled=0 in accordance with the 23 October 2026 PHP informational advisory.

notes: CVE decisions are evidence-based applicability assessments, not exploit confirmations.
A potentially_affected result means the modeled preconditions are present; it does not prove successful exploitation.
Vendor/LTS packages may contain security backports without changing the upstream-looking PHP version.
